decisions.reason: Devore decoration fabric builds on the firm's existing design-led decorative textile knowledge, enabling effective assimilation of feedback and product improvement.
Transparent burnout decorative fabric is closely related to the firm's established burnout and sheer fabric expertise, supporting learning and commercial application.
Burnout decorative fabric fits within the firm's core decorative textile capabilities, allowing the firm to interpret early results and refine the product.
Velour-like upholstery fabric directly extends the firm's existing upholstery textile range, where it has deep related knowledge and customer insight.

Flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric requires technical certification and material knowledge less related to the firm's design-led decorative/upholstery base, limiting its ability to learn and improve.
Polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a functional commodity outside the firm's core decorative/upholstery knowledge, so the firm cannot easily assimilate feedback or improve it.
